stemMd:
The routes shown on the earliest map ______ from those on the revised edition. Several paths had been redirected after a bridge was built, and the later map records those changes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The subject routes is plural. Shown on the earliest map modifies it but does not alter agreement. The plural present-tense verb differ correctly describes the comparison.

distractorRationale.a: Routes is plural, so the singular verb does not agree.
distractorRationale.d: The singular auxiliary has does not agree with routes.
distractorRationale.c: The singular auxiliary is does not agree with routes.
